units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3b:21">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מעולם לא עבר … בש׳</he> midnight never found me asleep.
<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:1">Ib. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ בעמוד וכ׳</he> sleep at morning dawn (v. <cite ref="U00969"><he>שֵׁינָא</he> I</cite>).
<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>במוסר שֵׁינָתוֹ וכ׳</he> when he gives his sleep in charge of others (gives orders to wake him up).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:4">Yoma I, 4</cite> <he>המאכל מביא את הש׳</he> eating causes sleepiness.
<cite ref="Tamid 28a:9">Tam. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אונס ש׳</he> being overcome by sleep.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93b:10">Snh. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>שהיו אונסין … ומן הש׳</he> they forced themselves not to laugh, talk, or fall asleep.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:10">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>עשרה ש׳ וכ׳</he> ten measures of sleep have come down to the world, nine of which the slaves have taken &c.; a. fr.
